title: TNew Apocalypse Structure TNAS
description: this project add new zombie apocalypse structure
body: You're tired of the lack of structure mods for 1.21.1 and above. This mod fixes that and adds about a dozen new structures that are perfect for a zombie apocalypse, especially for builds with the Tacz mod. The mod is still in development and is currently in alpha, but you can support us by simply telling others about it. :)
